newsitem.title: USA: Commercial Federal Corp Q2 Dec 31 net up.
newsitem.headline: Commercial Federal Corp Q2 Dec 31 net up.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: Per share amounts were adjusted to reflect a three-for-two stock split.

NOTE: Q2 fiscal 1997 net includes extraordinary loss on early retirement of debt totaling after-tax $583,000 or $0.03 a share. Q2 fiscal 1996 net includes an after-tax charge of $1.5 million or $0.07 a share related to the acquisition of Railroad Financial and a non-recurring charge of $537,000 or $0.03 a share related to the company's fiscal 1995 proxy contest. Operating income for Q2, excluding the above charges, was $0.71 a share versus $0.64.
(All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: Excluding one-time items and the SAIF special assessment, operating earnings for the six months ended December 31, 1996 were $1.38 a share versus $1.21 the previous year.
